evidence_against: Most of the recent window is range, not trend: bars 51-84 (34 bars) and 88-107 (20 bars) are overlapping two-sided structures, so 54 of the last 69 bars are range bars even though the swing sequence is bullish.
Price is at the extreme top of the window and bar 119 (high 2776.18, close 2752.43) fails to exceed bar 118's 2850 and closes below its open, a pause bar immediately after a spike bar.

Upper tails appear on the largest bars: bar 118 closes 74.39 below its 2850 high on a 208-point range (about 36 percent of the bar) and bar 85 closes 41.64 below its 2293.80 high, showing selling into strength at the highs.

The advance from 1916.51 (bar 85) to 2850 (+49 percent) in 34 bars has had no sustained multi-bar retracement after bar 87, a profile at least as compatible with spike/climax behaviour as with a mature channel; in this method a spike leg alone does not establish that the next leg continues.
evidence_for: Swing progression since bar 31 is a clean sequence of higher highs and higher lows: 1944.39 (bar 50) to 2771 (bar 87) to 2850 (bar 118), with rising lows at 1512.91 (bar 31), 1803.74 (bar 52), 2357.18 (bar 99) and 2358.62 (bar 112).

Two large bull bars produced accepted breakouts: bar 85 (range 388, close 2252.16) ended the 34-bar 1803.74-1974.46 range and price never closed back below 2111 (bar 86 low); bar 118 then closed 2775.61 near the window high after taking out 2771.

Pullbacks inside the post-bar-85 advance are shallow relative to the legs (2557.46 to 2357.18 is about 8 percent), and the 20-bar consolidation at bars 88-107 held well above the prior breakout, the behaviour of a trending market rather than a two-sided range.

Nine of the last twelve bars (108, 109, 111, 113, 114, 115, 116, 117, 118) closed above their opens, and the last five closes are all above 2397, so the most recent leg has directional follow-through.

structures.description: Bear swing, bars 0-11: eleven lower closes from 2072.79 to 1568.55; 12 bars carry price from the 2138.82 window high down to 1368.42, and bar 11's long lower tail with a close back at 1568.55 marks climactic rejection of that low rather than a clean close at the extreme.

Post-selloff trading range, bars 12-36: two-sided, overlapping bars between 1512.91 (bar 31 low) and 1845.09 (bar 20 high); the second half (bars 22-36) sits in a lower band near 1551-1740 with three separate low tests around 1551.60-1560.05.

Bull leg, bars 37-50: higher closes from bar 37's 1597.72 low to bar 50's 1944.39 high, including a large bull bar at 49 (open 1775.60, close 1889.93) and a 1804.49-1828.20 high zone at bars 40-41. This leg lifts price out of the 1512.91-1845.09 base.

Large trading range, bars 51-84: 34 bars rotating between 1803.74 (bar 52 low) and 1974.46 (bar 62 high), with 1954-1959 highs at bars 57 and 61; bars 74-84 compress into a tight ~1868-1919 zone on small bodies before the breakout.
Bull spike, bars 85-87: bar 85 breaks the 34-bar range with a 388-point bar (open 1916.51, high 2293.80, close 2252.16), and bars 86-87 continue to 2771, an ~850-point advance in three bars.

Bull-flag range, bars 88-107: 20 overlapping bars between 2357.18 (bar 99 low) and 2557.46 (bar 93 high), all holding far above the bar-85 breakout low; bar 112 later dips back to 2358.62 inside this general zone.

Second bull breakout, bars 108-119: bar 108 (open 2437) closes 2514.72 at high 2680, a five-bar pullback reaches 2358.62 (bar 112), then bars 115-118 run to a new window high 2850 (bar 118, close 2775.61) before bar 119 stalls with a 2776.18 high.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a daily close above 2850 (bar 118 high) with the close in the upper half of the bar and no close below 2716.01 (bar 119 low) keeps the breakout-spike read and extends the higher-high sequence.
Shift to range: several consecutive closes back inside 2357.18-2557.46 (the bar 88-107 band) without a new high would make the post-bar-85 structure a trading range and move phase toward 'range'.
Trend-doubt: a close below 2436.87 (bar 115 low) or 2435.72 (bar 108 low) would break the higher low that the latest leg tested and push primary_regime toward transition-unclear.

Larger reversal evidence: a close below 2358.62 (bar 112 low) followed by a lower swing high would break the last higher low of the bull sequence and make a retracement toward 2111 (bar 86 low) the dominant structural read.

Acceleration or exhaustion: another bull bar with a range above 250 closing at a new high confirms the spike phase, while a bear reversal bar closing below 2716.01 after a new high would raise the mtr-like top alternative to the current read.

evidence_against: The spike bar's 127-point upper tail (high 2850 vs close 2723.15) is a poor close that can mark a buy climax, and no bar since has closed above 2775.61.
Eleven overlapping, small-range bars with no new high show follow-through has stalled, so the current structure is two-sided and an always-in long is stale.
The last bar is a bear reversal bar closing at 2741.96 near its low, giving back the prior bar's close (2772.99) from the top of the 11-bar range.
Spikes in this window have not always continued: 1789128000000 spiked to 2680 and closed 2555.52, after which price declined to 2358.62.
evidence_for: Higher lows across the window (2358.62, 2370.54, 2569.8) and a decisive leg from 2569.8 to 2850 carried by consecutive large bull bars.
The 2700 level touched twice at exactly 2700 was broken and all 11 post-spike lows hold above it, i.e. some acceptance above the breakout point.
The pullback low 2716.01 retraces only about 48% of the 2569.8-2850 advance and the range lows keep rising, which is flag-like rather than reversal-like price action.
Follow-through before the range: closes 2754.31, 2760.51, 2775.61 and a marginal new high 2804.59 after the spike bar.

structures.description: Post-spike tight trading range / bull flag: the 11 bars after the 2850 high overlap between 2716.01 (low, 1790049600000) and 2804.59 (high, 1790020800000), with lows drifting up from 2716.01 to 2737.35 and highs still capped below 2804.59.

Bull spike that broke the 2700 double touch (exact highs 2700 at 1789804800000 and 1789948800000): three large bull bars from 1789905600000 to 1789977600000 drove to 2850, and all lows since 1789992000000 have held above 2700.

Possible buy-climax / exhaustion bar: 1789977600000 spans 2658.06-2850 and closes 2723.15, leaving a 127-point upper tail; no later bar exceeded 2804.59 and the latest bar closed at 2741.96 near its low.

Dominant early/mid-window two-sided range below the 2700 ceiling, with intermediate swing highs 2537.57, 2544.63, 2680 and 2609.02 against swing lows 2358.62 and 2370.54; the current spike is the first sustained break of this range's upper area.
Higher-low sequence off the window low: 2358.62 (1789488000000) -> 2370.54 (1789574400000) -> 2569.8 (1789862400000), the low from which the bull leg to 2850 launched.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2804.59 (then above 2850) on a large bull body would confirm the flag resolving upward and move the phase back toward breakout-spike.
Bear shift: consecutive closes below 2716.01, or any close back below the 2700 breakout level, would end acceptance of the breakout and change the read from bull-trend continuation to trading-range.

Roughly 5-10 further bars overlapping inside 2716.01-2804.59 would make the range the dominant structure and move primary_regime toward trading-range; a series of higher lows and closes pressing the range high would instead suggest a channel.
An mtr-like top would only form if price makes a lower high below 2804.59 and then breaks the intervening higher low at 2716.01.
